source:
@@U01799@@
Time will come when all good people
will shrink from you, you whore,
as though you were a rotting,
plague-ridden corpse.
They'll look you in the eye,
and your heart will break.
No more golden necklaces for you!
No more standing by the altar! No more
fun at the dance in a fine lace collar!
Youll hide away in some miserable
hole among beggars and cripples,
and even if God forgives you,
you'll be damned here on earth forever!

@@U01801@@
Commend your soul to God’s mercy!
Will you burden yourself with slander, too?

@@U01803@@
You shameless pandering bitch!
If only I could get at your withered body
my soul would be wiped clear of sin!

@@U01805@@
My brother!
Oh, the agony!

@@U01807@@
No more tears!
I’ve had enough!
The day you destroyed your honor
was the day you stabbed me to the heart.
I'm going to God—
a soldier good and true.

@@U01808@@
(He dies.)
translation:
@@U01799@@
总有一天，所有好人都会
会躲避你，你这个妓女，
就好像你是一个腐烂的人，
满身瘟疫的尸体。
他们会看着你的眼睛
你的心会碎。
不再给你金项链了！
不再站在祭坛旁！没有了
穿着精致的蕾丝衣领跳舞，尽享欢乐！
你会躲进一些悲惨的地方
乞丐和瘸子中间的洞，
即使上帝原谅了你，
你将永远在地球上被诅咒！

@@U01801@@
称赞你的灵魂受到上帝的仁慈！
你也会被诽谤所累吗？

@@U01803@@
你这个无耻的、贪图便宜的贱人！
如果我能得到你枯萎的身体就好了
我的灵魂将被清除罪孽！

@@U01805@@
我的兄弟！
哦，痛苦！

@@U01807@@
别再流泪了！
我受够了！
你毁掉你的荣誉的那一天
就是你刺伤我心脏的那一天。
我要去见上帝——
一个善良而真实的士兵。

@@U01808@@
（他死了。）
